continuation.interruption: PG restarted; caches not controlled; sum original six and remaining three CLI times, excluding the interruption

contract.comparison: complete referenced result except result_id and input_id
contract.candidates: distinct available results linked to stored events with the same scope, profile, database, execution_user, rule, approximate value and timing type; NULL event timing means unknown
contract.boundary: stored same-dimension events, not reconstruction of the first build candidate set

old.access: SELECT on product tables; temporary comparison DDL only, rolled back; autovacuum disabled

new.access: SELECT on product tables; temporary comparison DDL only, rolled back; autovacuum disabled

historical_stops.resolution: Memory peaks are recorded only; user approved continuation from the preserved database.
Only the representative column uses the three confirmed equivalence conditions; original failed comparison retained, no task replay.

other_load: Shared development host; not isolated from other sessions. Small bundle/Harness checks ran during the old first task; a final packaging regression (about 0.3 seconds) ran during the new first task. Database checks and the two measured replays ran serially. Read-only progress probes were bounded. Private process/load snapshots are retained. Before continuation, copied the stopped new run and rechecked all 55 input files. The PostgreSQL instance was restarted; database and OS caches were not normalized. During the remaining three tasks, only lightweight source/document review and progress reads accompanied the replay. No other acceptance database run was started by this session; other host sessions were not isolated.

observation_reference_diagnosis.method: Read-only 1074-row per-field hash comparison with the original result-ID mapping; no original values returned.
observation_reference_diagnosis.limits: Candidate counts cover all stored results matching rule/value, not the original build-time eligible set. No same-interpreter repeated replay was performed. This diagnosis does not relax or rerun the failed acceptance comparison.
observation_reference_diagnosis.interpretation: The existing representative selection orders by result_id, which depends on a UUID-based approximate input ID. The observed reference differences are consistent with that mechanism; interpreter causation was not established.

completion_scope: Developer nine-task comparison under the confirmed contract; target P9-P11 not run.

metadata.access: SELECT on product tables; temporary comparison DDL only, rolled back; autovacuum disabled
